lines: Scripture; Psalm 24;1
Our God, Creator of the universe,
Our God, the Lord of all the earth,
We praise and magnify his glorious name;
He is all the world to you and me.
Let ev'ry kneww beofre Him humbly bow;
He reigns supremely over all.
Through Him all things created now exist;
He holds the scepter in His hand.
For God so loved us, even sinners;
He gave His only son to die,
And on the cross our debt was gladly paid;
Jesus died that you and I might live.
And at the time of my departure,
As it must come for ev'ry man,
Let not my loved ones weep in sorrow;
My soul is in my Father's hands.
But * listen to the wondrous story,
The very tho't will thrill your soul,
That God, the Ruler of the world
Is the lovingt Father of us all.
